title: Execution Compression and Overinstrumentation Guard
owner_directive: Fix overinstrumentation across the entire system from Operations V3 so every executor receives the same one-door instructions. Durable lane state is for coarse recovery milestones, not an activity log. Collapse closeout to a bounded fast path and prevent CI/job/status/queue micro-transitions from creating redundant receipts, reads, commits or narration.
reproduced_failures: MRCS-03 completed correctly but produced a very large activity trail dominated by status reads, artifact inspections, CI/platform micro-checks, queue re-reads and lane-state receipt writes around a small number of real state transitions.

The canonical OPS3 bootstrap currently says to record a lane-state progress receipt after each material durable side effect, which encourages executors to duplicate repository/PR/CI/queue truth into the lane journal.
MRCS-03 required a second owner Continue and was correctly marked nonconforming even though product results were valid.

MRCS closeout separately recorded/inspected closeout candidate creation, prequeue validation, queue submission, integration binding, merge verification, queue reconciliation and successor reseed instead of treating these as one bounded closeout phase.
Successor reseed shape was rediscovered from another lane rather than produced deterministically by the shared lane-state helper.
This project has a months-long pattern of instrumentation/governance machinery becoming its own workload; OPS3 must explicitly optimize for fewer transitions, fewer reads and fewer durable writes.
repair_scope: Make operations/BOOTSTRAP.md and OPERATING_CONTRACT.md explicitly prohibit overinstrumentation and define milestone receipts rather than activity receipts.

Replace generic lane-state journaling with a small state machine: selected_not_started -> in_progress -> prequeue_green -> published -> deterministic successor reseed. Ordinary attempts get no other lane-journal transitions.
Make repository/PR/CI/publication-queue state the durable evidence for intermediate mechanics; do not mirror each observation into lane state.
Add deterministic successor reseed helper so executors never inspect another lane to learn the reset shape.

Define a closeout fast path: validate closeout candidate -> READY CAS -> fresh-main integration check -> exact merge -> durable queue reconcile -> one successor reseed. No lane receipts inside that phase.
Ban lane-state writes for PR creation, CI queued/running, per-platform green, artifact inspection, queue submission, fresh-main reads, merge preparation, merge verification or queue reconciliation.
Require batching of related reads/writes and prohibit status-only microsteps from being described as material progress.
Add regression coverage based on the MRCS-03 overinstrumentation pattern and preserve the ready-then-queue architecture from OPS3-10.
Preserve MSAS-05, MRCS-04 and MVPS-13 selected_not_started throughout the repair.

last_material_progress.evidence: OPS3-11 start candidate freezes product starts and preserves MSAS-05, MRCS-04 and MVPS-13 while the one-door anti-overinstrumentation repair is implemented.

next_action: Publish the OPS3-11 governed start through the existing READY-candidate protocol, then implement milestone-only lane state, deterministic successor reseed, closeout fast-path instructions and overinstrumentation regressions; validate and close OPS3-11 in this same owner execution.
